description: Synoptic Panel Lite provides the core functionality of Synoptic Panel while meeting Power BI's stringent certification requirements. This streamlined version omits advanced features like remote map loading and My Storage, yet still delivers robust map-based visualizations and multi-level navigation. Key Features Multi-Level Navigation Retain the ability to drill through multiple hierarchy levels, revealing deeper insights and more granular data connections. Local Map Loading Reliably load maps from local files without relying on external hosting, ensuring greater control and security in enterprise settings. Map Filtering Use Power BI's native filtering capabilities to switch between maps or focus on specific regions, all within a single report. Integrated Map Editor Make quick adjustments to data bindings directly within the visual, without complex or time-consuming external tools. Integrated Label Editor Edit labels directly within the visual, ensuring the aesthetics and accuracy of your maps are always on point. Comprehensive Map Manager Manage all loaded maps in one place, simplifying how you organize, edit, and share your visual resources. Customization Options Keep the visual design consistent with brand guidelines by customizing colors, labels, and more—now with built-in conditional formatting.
